title: Service inquiry preparation — original demo plan
problem: SYNTHETIC: a visible quote link does not provide the prerequisites it promises.
improvement: Show a clear service-area check, preparation checklist and next-step explanation.
demo_plan: Build a local fictional three-service guide with a mock quote-preparation path. Do not submit to a real business.
simulated: All businesses, service areas, inquiries, prices and appointments are fictional. No form is transmitted.
benefit_hypothesis: A clearer preparation route may reduce confusion; demand, saved time and revenue effects are unknown.
measurement: Compare whether reviewers can identify the next step and prerequisites on three held-out tasks, with task time and misunderstanding counts.
pricing_assumptions: No quoted price. Time-box a prototype to two hours; scope, costs and commercial pricing require a separate agreement.
question: What information do you need before you can quote a repair, and where do customers get stuck?
